_readme: MB1's member items, each mapped to the tests that can red it ALONE.
GATE.md §8: items are committed one per member item exactly so a bad one can be
reverted alone. That only helps if the pack can say WHICH item broke, so every
row here is run as its own `flutter test` invocation with its own verdict.
`class` is the GATE.md §3 evidence class the row can produce. Rows whose real
claim needs a phone say `device`/`capture` and are BLOCKED here by construction —
they are NOT substituted with a suite test that passes with the feature off.

items.title: rework of the two KEPT test files
FCM re-registration on login / user-switch (proof-only rider)
the stale doc-comment cleanups, repo-wide over EVERY tracked file
owner ruling 2026-07-31 #2 — MSI as the first Dev Tool preset

items.title: two-model review + merge
items.note: No local predicate, and MB1.md forbids it acquiring a CI one (owner exclusion 2 makes 'CI is green' unsatisfiable as evidence). Reported, never scored.

items.title: the device round — THE WIRE and THE MARKER
items.note: Requires a recorder DB and an on-device diag JSONL from a real round. The instrument self-tests (--selftest) so V-2 gets a proven reader, but a self-test proves the READER, never the product. GATE.md §4: BLOCKED is not a pass.

items.title: the pre-R1 MSI push-dispatch control
items.note: Needs a live bearer token minted through a device/seam login. Against MSI 192.168.2.39:10090 only. Proves the gateway ACCEPTED a dispatch; arrival is V-2's shade.
